title: Eager to Do the Work
summary: The early church was intentional about its mission. What is the Lord putting on your heart? You were bought with a price and made for good works.
exhortation: What is your purpose? What is your mission? What is the thing you are eager to do?

I love the intentionality in this passage. Peter, John, James, Barnabas, Paul and the early Christians were thinking and strategizing about how to accomplish the mission of the kingdom, evaluating each person's gifts and considering how to take the gospel to the ends of the earth. It wasn't haphazard. They brought it before the Lord, weighed their gifts, and asked what each one's calling was. Something was burning in their hearts. Once they discovered it through prayer, fasting, study and fellowship, they were eager to do the work of the Lord: Barnabas and Paul to the Gentiles, Peter to the Jews.

So what is on your heart, Christian? What is the Lord stirring in you so that you are about the business of your King? We all have a mission field, and we should all be investing in the kingdom of God. It starts closest to home: showing love and kindness to your own family, your church and your city, remembering the poor and the weakest among you. Let's make the name of Christ known wherever we go.

If the Lord is prompting you with something in particular, a vision or a mission, step into it today. You were bought with a price. Jesus purchased you with his own blood, and he has prepared good works in advance for you to walk in. You are on this earth with purpose, mission and meaning. Our lives are not meaningless. They are full of purpose in Jesus Christ because of what he has done for us. How can we not speak?
prayer: God, what a gift it is to have your Holy Spirit empowering us. It's such a great mission and such a huge harvest, and in ourselves we aren't equal to the task. But it's your work, and you've opened our eyes to see the harvest.

I pray for discouraged hearts that have been praying for, talking to and trying to convince someone they love, or a people they love. Lift them out of discouragement to see your power, grace and love. Let the cross where you died affect us again as we see how much you love us and the world, that you would shed your own blood, and let that give us confidence and a passion to preach your word to a lost and dying world. Go with us today. Open our eyes, and fill us with strength, passion and energy for your mission once again. In Jesus' name.
